core_obligations: Parts (1) and (2) (proof lines 12085-12100): let F^bullet be any complex representing E and take X, {U_i -> X}, alpha_i as in (1); after refining the covering, the local representability lemma lets the alpha_i be represented by maps of complexes into F^bullet|U_i, whose cohomology properties then show that F^bullet itself is m-pseudo-coherent as a complex, giving (1) and the case of (2) when C has a final object.

Part (2) in general (proof lines 12101-12104): the preceding argument shows F^bullet|U is m-pseudo-coherent as a complex of O_U-modules for every object U of C, and it is a formal consequence of the definitions that F^bullet is then m-pseudo-coherent.
Part (3) (proof lines 12105-12107): local m-pseudo-coherence on the members of a covering of each object implies the global statement by the definitions and the covering axioms for a site.
proof_roadmap: Represent the local maps by maps of complexes on a refinement and deduce pseudo-coherence of the chosen representative.
Pass from all localisations to the global statement for the representative.
Conclude locality of the notion from the covering axioms.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states three properties of m-pseudo-coherence: locality on a covering when C has a final object, independence of the representing complex, and locality in general (statement lines 12065-12082). The proof (proof lines 12084-12107) represents the local maps by maps of complexes on a refinement, reads off pseudo-coherence of an arbitrary representative, passes from localisations to the global statement, and invokes the covering axioms for the general local case. H2: two short arguments from the definitions, written out.
